title: HiddenUplift
description: Internal oracle evaluation schema containing unobservable ground truth, counterfactuals, and latent parameters. Strictly forbidden in any training, validation, or test feature set.

natural_transaction_propensity.description: Latent customer propensity to transact without an incentive.

qr_affinity.description: Latent customer inclination toward QR / merchant pay channels.

price_sensitivity.description: Latent sensitivity modifying the treatment effect based on incentive magnitude.

digital_maturity.description: Latent customer comfort with app channel vs agent/USSD.

offer_fatigue.description: Latent annoyance accumulated from recent prior campaign exposures.

p_y_control.description: Potential outcome probability of transacting under control condition (no offer).

p_y_treat.description: Potential outcome probability of transacting under treatment condition (offer received).

true_uplift.description: Unobservable true individual treatment effect: p_y_treat - p_y_control. Strictly reserved for oracle evaluation.
